name: FOMC + post-OpEx window
tagline: Owns TQQQ in the FOMC intermeeting drift and the post-OpEx flow window, halved in volatility spikes and in BIL otherwise.
summary: A standalone calendar strategy that holds TQQQ from FOMC decision +3 through +20 and from monthly OpEx +1 through +3, with BIL otherwise, and halves exposure when the 20-day/100-day TQQQ realised-vol ratio exceeds 1.25. The 2016-2023 development backtest at 1 bp earns 58.26% CAGR / 42.60% max drawdown / 1.36 Sharpe at 55.4% mean TQQQ exposure; the calendar is hardcoded ex-ante through 2026-10-23, and the 2024-2026 holdout has not been run.
caveat: The dev CAGR is concentrated in 2020-2023: the calm 2016-2019 subperiod returns 34.4% (below the 36.72% bar and 15.6 pp below TQQQ) and the ex-2020 CAGR is 37.49%, only 0.8 pp above the bar.
